name: Dashboard loads live time and compact weather forecast
covers: live clock and date display
generic time-based Good morning, Good afternoon, or Good evening greeting without a family name
browser location permission and device GPS-based local weather lookup
reverse-geocoded current-area label without a hardcoded city
location-denied guidance and manual location retry
7-day high and low forecast
daily precipitation chance
UV index, sunrise, sunset and wind details
condition-based animated weather background
compact modular dark weather dashboard with location header, current conditions, UV, wind, humidity and sunrise/sunset cards
responsive weather layout with compact 7-day outlook and no hourly forecast section
pause and resume weather animation
reduced-motion accessibility
installed PWA launches in full-screen display mode with standalone fallback
description: Verifies the dashboard requests browser location permission, shows weather for the device's current area, and provides a compact weekly forecast with controllable condition-based background effects.
steps: Open the HomeHub dashboard and allow location access when the browser asks
Verify the displayed place reflects the device's current area and review the daily forecast and weather detail cards
Pause and resume the animated weather background
expected: The dashboard asks for browser location access and uses the device's actual latitude and longitude to load current conditions and forecasts for that area, with a matching nearby place name when available. It never silently substitutes Regina. If permission is denied or unavailable, it explains how to enable location and offers a retry. The dashboard also shows a generic time-based greeting, a 7-day forecast, weather details, condition-based background animation with pause/resume, respects reduced-motion preference, and requests full-screen launch mode when installed with standalone fallback. The weather area uses a compact modular dark dashboard layout with a location/live header, current conditions panel, separate UV, wind, humidity and sunrise/sunset metric cards, and a 7-day outlook with no hourly forecast section. It uses live device-local weather values only; no sample city, fake air-quality value or hardcoded temperatures are shown.

name: Create and retain household calendar events
covers: manual event creation
event date and time selection
selected-date agenda and upcoming event rendering
local date handling across time zones
month calendar alignment and event markers
weather, calendar and agenda dashboard layout
description: Verifies household events can be scheduled for a chosen future date and time and remain available after refreshing the dashboard.
steps: Choose Add event in Today's agenda
Enter Family dinner as the event name
Choose a future date and set the time to 6:30 PM
Save the event and open the matching calendar date
expected: The event is saved with the selected date and 6:30 PM time, appears under the selected date in the upcoming list and month calendar, and the dashboard sections remain visible.

missing OAuth configuration guidance
responsive tablet and mobile settings
description: Verifies the dashboard explains the required Google OAuth setup and prevents a connection attempt without a client ID.

Close settings and select Sync calendar

name: UCB Radio live playback and audio-reactive soundwave
covers: live UCB Radio Canada stream playback
station location picker grouped by province
retained station selection after reload
automatic audio-reactive soundwave synced to the UCB stream
soundwave returns to idle when radio pauses
live, buffering and error playback feedback
interactive tone bars remain playable while radio is playing
selectable synthesizer sound waveforms
adjustable synthesizer volume
responsive side-by-side radio and synthesizer layout
description: Verifies the UCB Radio card plays a live Canadian station, lets the listener choose a station location, and drives the soundwave from the actual stream audio without a browser sharing prompt.
steps: Open the HomeHub dashboard and locate the UCB Radio card
Choose a station location from the Station location picker
Press Play live radio and verify the UCB stream starts and the soundwave reacts to the audio automatically
Change to a different station location while playing and verify playback switches to that feed
Press Pause radio and verify audio stops and the soundwave returns to idle
Choose a different synthesizer sound and tap several soundwave bars
Reload the dashboard and verify the chosen station location is retained
expected: The UCB Radio card starts and pauses a live UCB Radio Canada stream from a single button. The station location picker lists the national feeds and city stations grouped by province, persists the choice locally, and switches the live stream without a page reload. While audio plays, the soundwave bars react automatically to the real stream through the Web Audio API, with no tab-sharing prompt; they return to idle when playback pauses, and a status line reports connecting, buffering, live and error states. Synth bars remain playable while the radio is on, sound selection changes the tone, volume adjusts loudness, and the layout stacks cleanly on mobile.
